prose: OpenAI acquired Odessia, the AI travel agent founded by Sonder founder Francis Davidson, who joins OpenAI to work on the future of travel. Terms undisclosed; looks like an acqui-hire. Odessia was a year old, had raised $6M led by Sequoia, launched five months ago, and has already shut down; Davidson says early users planned millions of dollars of travel. OpenAI confirmed the hire but announced no travel product.
highlights: $6M pre-seed led by Sequoia; product already shut
